BrochureContent.Content:
DNG are delighted to present No. 13 Harcourt Mews, a superb second-floor, two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment ideally located in the heart of Dublin 2. This bright and spacious residence enjoys a desirable dual-aspect design, allowing natural light to flood the accommodation throughout, while two private balconies on either side of the apartment provide excellent outdoor space and a wonderful sense of openness.

The well-proportioned accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway with excellent storage, a generous open-plan living and dining room with floor-to-ceiling glazing and direct access to one of the private balconies, creating the perfect setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The adjoining kitchen is fitted with an excellent range of contemporary units and integrated appliances.

There are two spacious double bedrooms, both enjoying excellent natural light. The principal bedroom benefits from a stylish en-suite shower room together whilst the secind bedroom enjoys direct access on to a private balcony A modern family bathroom completes the accommodation.

No. 13 Harcourt Mews enjoys an enviable city centre location just a short stroll from St. Stephen's Green, Grafton Street and Harcourt Street, placing an unrivalled selection of cafés, restaurants, shops and cultural amenities on your doorstep. The area is exceptionally well served by public transport, with the Luas Green Line and numerous Dublin Bus routes within walking distance, ensuring easy access to all parts of the city.

Offering bright, well-appointed accommodation, a highly sought-after dual-aspect layout, an Impressive B BER rating and the rare benefit of two private balconies, No. 13 Harcourt Mews represents an exceptional opportunity for first-time buyers, those trading down, investors and anyone seeking a stylish city centre home in one of Dublin's most desirable locations.

• Bright second-floor apartment
  • B BER rating
  • Spacious dual-aspect layout
  • Two generous double bedrooms
  • Two bathrooms, including principal en-suite
  • Two private balconies
  • Spacious open-plan living and dining area
  • Fully fitted contemporary kitchen
  • Excellent natural light throughout
  • Secure and well-maintained development
  • Prime Dublin 2 location
  • Walking distance to St. Stephen's Green, Grafton Street and Harcourt Street
  • Luas Green Line and numerous Dublin Bus routes nearby
